summary: Four incoming and eight outgoing stage interfaces across six partner roadmaps, plus one radical-API overlap. The screen distinguishes composition Cartan matrices from symmetrized Euler matrices, controls acyclic versus doubled quivers and keeps finite-module stable quotients separate from Frobenius triangulations. See handoff for exact coverage, source corrections and validation. Two further independently examined quiver-to-zigzag edges were omitted because they landed in the Zigzag packet during this run.
